text.name: rms_drivetrain_warning_4wd_windup
text.text: Drivetrain under stress! Disengage the front axle to turn on a high-grip surface.

text.name: rms_drivetrain_warning_difflock_windup
text.text: Differential lock under stress! Release it or reduce the steering angle.

text.name: rms_preheat_system_failure_message
text.text: Preheating system failure: cold start unavailable

text.name: rms_preheat_start_failed_message
text.text: Engine did not start: switch the ignition off before retrying

text.name: input_RMS_TOGGLE_DIFFLOCK
text.text: Engage or release the differential lock

text.name: input_RMS_TOGGLE_PARKBRAKE
text.text: Engage or release the parking brake

text.name: rms_settings_admin_required
text.text: RMS settings require administrator permissions in multiplayer.

text.name: rms_maintenancePrice_tooltip
text.text: Adjusts the cost of all workshop procedures, including inspections, repairs, and overhauls. A higher value makes them more expensive.

text.name: rms_maintenanceDuration_tooltip
text.text: Sets the duration of all workshop procedures. The higher the value, the longer each procedure takes.

text.name: rms_workshopOpenHour_tooltip
text.text: Procedures only start from this hour onward.

text.name: rms_workshopCloseHour_tooltip
text.text: Procedures in progress are paused at this hour and resume when the workshop opens.

text.name: rms_cloggingSpeed_tooltip
text.text: Adjusts how quickly the radiator and air filter clog while working in dust, chaff, and crop residue. Higher values make clogging build up faster.

text.name: rms_fieldInspectionDuration_tooltip
text.text: Sets how long a pre-shift check takes, in real seconds.

text.name: rms_lubricationReducePerOperatingHour_tooltip
text.text: Sets how much grease is consumed per operating hour.

text.name: rms_dealerWorkshopAvailable_tooltip
text.text: Keeps the dealer workshop available at any hour of the day or night.

text.name: rms_mobileWorkshopAvailable_tooltip
text.text: Keeps the mobile workshop available at any hour of the day or night.

text.name: rms_mobileWorkshopRestrictions_tooltip
text.text: When the option is enabled, the availability of each procedure in the mobile workshop depends on the vehicle's ease of maintenance.

text.name: rms_ownWorkshopAvailable_tooltip
text.text: Keeps your personal workshop available at any hour of the day or night.

text.name: rms_instantInspection_tooltip
text.text: When the option is enabled, all inspections complete instantly, with no time passing. Note: the visual inspection becomes unavailable.

text.name: rms_parkVehicle_tooltip
text.text: When the option is enabled, vehicles undergoing maintenance are skipped when switching with TAB.

text.name: rms_warrantyEnabled_tooltip
text.text: Applies warranty coverage to repairs on new vehicles (up to 20 operating hours or 12 months). Only original parts are covered free of charge.

text.name: rms_aiOverloadAndOverheatControl_tooltip
text.text: When the option is enabled, the AI worker reduces load to prevent engine overload or overheating.

text.name: rms_aiDisableOnCriticalOverload_tooltip
text.text: Stops AI workers and AutoDrive during a critical overload.

text.name: rms_contractVehicleProtection_tooltip
text.text: Applies to contract vehicles the AI shutdown on critical overload as well as the speed regulation on overload or overheating.

text.name: rms_aiWorkerTargetStress_tooltip
text.text: Controls how early the AI worker reacts to overload and overheating. The higher the sensitivity, the earlier the worker slows down; the lower it is, the more load it lets build up before stepping in.

text.name: rms_aiWorkerMinSpeed_tooltip
text.text: Sets the lowest AI worker cruise-control speed allowed while reducing speed to avoid overload or overheating.

text.name: rms_debugMode_tooltip
text.text: Enables the debug panel and detailed logs in the console.

text.name: rms_warningMessages_tooltip
text.text: Enables or disables gameplay warning messages such as cold engine and overheating alerts.

text.name: rms_serviceInterval_tooltip
text.text: Sets the base maintenance interval in hours, beyond which maintenance is required. The actual interval depends on the vehicle brand, its age, and the quality of previous maintenance.

text.name: rms_vehicleLifespan_tooltip
text.text: Sets the base vehicle lifespan in hours, after which its condition reaches 0%. The closer the condition is to zero, the more unreliable the vehicle becomes.

text.name: rms_reinitializeVehicles_tooltip
text.text: Realigns the fleet condition on the selected vehicle lifespan. Current breakdowns are cleared.

text.name: rms_reinitializeVehiclesConfirm_message
text.text: Realign the fleet on the selected lifespan? Current breakdowns will be cleared.

text.name: rms_downtimeWear_tooltip
text.text: Sets the passive wear rate while a vehicle is idle as a percentage of the base wear rate (Vehicle Lifespan). For example, 5% with the default 100-hour lifespan means each system loses about 1% condition after roughly 20 hours of downtime. Note: passive wear is disabled while the vehicle is stored under cover.

text.name: rms_generalWearEnabled_tooltip
text.text: As the vehicle wears out, each system receives small penalties to its core characteristics, such as engine power, hydraulic speed, or brake efficiency. The effect becomes active after the first third of the vehicle lifespan, but only becomes truly noticeable after the second third and grows stronger toward the end of the machine's life.

text.name: rms_exhaustSmokeEnabled_tooltip
text.text: Drives the exhaust plume from the real state of the engine. It is black when fuel outruns the available air: a hard pickup, an engine lugging at low speed, prolonged low-load idling, a clogged air filter or worn injection. It is blue when a tired engine burns oil, white when fuel leaves unburnt. The plume also grows with the work the engine is doing. Older machines smoke far more than modern ones, which barely smoke at all unless something is seriously wrong.

text.name: rms_exhaustSmokeIntensity_tooltip
text.text: Scales how visible the smoke is without changing what causes it. Higher values make symptoms easier to read from a distance.

text.name: rms_exhaustSmokeDetail_tooltip
text.text: Sets how much of the exhaust plume is drawn on your own computer, without changing anything for the other players. Lowering it strips the outer layers of smoke and eases the load on a modest graphics card. It can only reduce what the server allows.

text.name: rms_systemStressRate_tooltip
text.text: Controls how quickly stress builds up in systems from overload, overheating, wheel slip, and other harsh operating conditions. Stress directly affects breakdown probability: the more stress a system accumulates, the more likely it is to fail.

text.name: rms_batteryCapacity_tooltip
text.text: Adjusts the maximum usable battery capacity. A value close to 150 Ah matches a real battery, but at that level you will hardly ever run into discharge problems.

text.name: rms_alternatorMaxOutput_tooltip
text.text: Sets the maximum alternator output current. Higher values allow the alternator to recharge the battery faster.

text.name: rms_idleCurrent_tooltip
text.text: Sets the battery drain current while the engine is stopped. For example, at 0.5 A a 15 Ah battery takes about 30 real hours to fully discharge, before temperature effects are applied.

text.name: rms_temperatureChangeSpeed_tooltip
text.text: Scales how quickly engine temperature changes. Lower values slow both heating and cooling; higher values speed them up. The default value is 1.4.

text.name: rms_transTemperatureChangeMultiplier_label
text.text: Transmission and Hydraulic Oil Thermal Speed

text.name: rms_transTemperatureChangeMultiplier_tooltip
text.text: Separately scales how quickly the shared transmission and hydraulic oil temperature changes. Lower values slow both heating and cooling; higher values speed them up. The default value is 1.0.

text.name: rms_radiatorDirtInfluence_tooltip
text.text: Reduces radiator cooling capacity by this percentage at maximum dirt buildup.

text.name: rms_tutorialResetTips_tooltip
text.text: Resets the tutorial tip history and shows every tip again.

text.name: rms_tutorialResetConfirm_message
text.text: Reset tutorial tip history and show all tips again?

text.name: rms_drivetrainEnabled_tooltip
text.text: Enables manual control of the driven front axle and the differential locks on tractors. When Enhanced Vehicle's differential control is active, the mod steps aside completely and Enhanced Vehicle handles the drivetrain alone.

text.name: rms_drivetrainAllowAutoMode_tooltip
text.text: Adds an AUTO position to the drive mode switch: the front axle engages automatically on wheel slip or at working speeds under load, and disengages on the road. Vehicles left in AUTO fall back to 4WD when this option is turned off.

text.name: rms_drivetrainWindupDamage_tooltip
text.text: Turning on a high-grip surface with locked differentials puts the drivetrain under stress and damages the transmission over time. Disable for a more forgiving experience.

text.name: rms_drivetrainDiffLockReleaseSpeed_tooltip
text.text: The differential locks disengage automatically above this speed and re-engage below it while requested.

text.name: rms_drivetrainParkBrakeEnabled_tooltip
text.text: Adds a parking brake to all tracked vehicles, toggled with its own key binding. The engaged brake holds the machine still and ignores the throttle.

text.name: rms_drivetrainParkBrakeAuto_tooltip
text.text: Engages the parking brake automatically when the operator leaves the standing machine.

text.name: rms_ws_info_inspection_reveals
text.text: An inspection can reveal further defects.

text.name: rms_ws_status_ready_hint
text.text: Select a procedure. Options, parts and price are confirmed before it starts.

text.name: rms_ws_info_no_breakdowns
text.text: No known breakdowns. An undetected breakdown remains possible.

text.name: rms_ws_cancel_confirm_text
text.text: Current progress will be saved as-is. No money will be refunded.

text.name: rms_mobile_workshop_low_maintainability
text.text: Warning: the %s procedure is unavailable for %s in the mobile workshop because this vehicle is too difficult to maintain on site.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_steering_linkage_wear_stage1_description
text.text: Light steering linkage wear. Steering becomes a little less precise.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_steering_linkage_wear_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate steering linkage wear. Free play increases, precision drops noticeably and road behavior degrades.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_steering_linkage_wear_stage3_description
text.text: Severe steering linkage wear. Free play is large, the steering responds poorly and controlling the vehicle becomes difficult.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_steering_linkage_wear_stage4_description
text.text: Critical steering linkage failure. Steering is no longer reliable and driving becomes dangerous.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_general_wear_stage1_description
text.text: The stress accumulated over years of service leaves minor, irreversible wear on the core components, which slightly reduces overall performance.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_glow_plug_failure_stage1_description
text.text: Early glow plug degradation. Cold starts are becoming slower; warm starts remain unaffected.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_glow_plug_failure_stage2_description
text.text: Several glow plugs are weak or inoperative. Cold starts are difficult and the engine may idle unevenly until it warms up.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_glow_plug_failure_stage3_description
text.text: Severe glow plug failure. Cold starting is highly unreliable and rough running persists during warm-up.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_glow_plug_failure_stage4_description
text.text: Complete glow plug failure. The engine cannot be started when the temperature is too low.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_powershift_hydraulic_pump_malfunction_stage1_description
text.text: Pressure loss at the Powershift hydraulic pump. Slight delay and harshness when shifting gears.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_powershift_hydraulic_pump_malfunction_stage2_description
text.text: Worn seals on the Powershift hydraulic pump. Noticeable lag and jolts when shifting gears.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_powershift_hydraulic_pump_malfunction_stage3_description
text.text: Powershift hydraulic pump failure. Severe delay and violent shocks when shifting gears.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_powershift_hydraulic_pump_malfunction_stage4_description
text.text: Powershift hydraulic pump failed. Transmission is stuck in neutral.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_drive_coupling_wear_stage1_description
text.text: Early PTO drive coupling wear. The PTO may occasionally disengage.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_drive_coupling_wear_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate PTO drive coupling wear. Disengagement becomes more frequent.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_drive_coupling_wear_stage3_description
text.text: Severe PTO drive coupling wear. The PTO disengages repeatedly.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_drive_coupling_wear_stage4_description
text.text: Critical PTO drive coupling failure. The PTO can no longer transmit power.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_drive_output_bearing_wear_stage1_description
text.text: Early wear of the PTO output shaft bearing causes a slight running noise.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_drive_output_bearing_wear_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate wear of the PTO output shaft bearing causes a clearly audible noise.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_drive_output_bearing_wear_stage3_description
text.text: Severe wear of the PTO output shaft bearing causes loud noise and occasional disengagement.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_drive_output_bearing_wear_stage4_description
text.text: Critical PTO output shaft failure. PTO operation is no longer possible.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_engagement_control_malfunction_stage1_description
text.text: The PTO engagement control responds intermittently and may refuse an engagement command.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_engagement_control_malfunction_stage2_description
text.text: The PTO engagement control frequently fails to engage the PTO.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_engagement_control_malfunction_stage3_description
text.text: The PTO engagement control is severely faulty and rejects most engagement attempts.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_pto_engagement_control_malfunction_stage4_description
text.text: The PTO engagement control has failed completely. The PTO cannot be engaged.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_defected_parts_detected_description
text.text: The system is functioning normally, but the inspection has revealed a defective part. The part no longer offers any safety margin, so preventive replacement is recommended to avoid sudden failure.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_temporarily_repaired_description
text.text: The system is functioning normally, but relies entirely on a temporary repair. To avoid a breakdown under load, a full replacement of the parts is recommended as soon as possible.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_turbocharger_wear_stage1_description
text.text: Worn turbocharger bearings. A faint whistling is audible and a slight loss of power appears at high engine speed.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_turbocharger_wear_stage2_description
text.text: Leaking turbocharger seals. Noticeable power loss and increased fuel consumption.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_turbocharger_wear_stage3_description
text.text: Damaged turbine blades. Severe power loss and a risk of engine stalls under heavy load.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_turbocharger_wear_stage4_description
text.text: Critical turbocharger failure. The engine has lost most of its power and risks severe internal damage.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_slip_stage1_description
text.text: Worn clutch plates. Occasional power loss due to clutch slip under load.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_slip_stage2_description
text.text: Significant clutch wear. Noticeable clutch slip during acceleration and under heavy load.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_slip_stage3_description
text.text: Heavily worn clutch. Severe clutch slip makes it difficult to transfer power to the wheels.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_slip_stage4_description
text.text: Clutch completely burned out. The vehicle is unable to move.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_synchronizer_malfunction_stage1_description
text.text: Worn synchronizers. Occasional grinding or difficulty when shifting gears.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_synchronizer_malfunction_stage2_description
text.text: Damaged synchronizers. Shifting gears is frequently difficult and may fail.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_synchronizer_malfunction_stage3_description
text.text: Broken synchronizer teeth. High chance of failed shifts or of jumping out of gear under load.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_synchronizer_malfunction_stage4_description
text.text: Synchronizers completely failed. It is impossible to shift gears.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_thermostat_malfunction_stage1_description
text.text: The transmission thermostat is beginning to fail. It opens the oil cooler too late and the transmission oil runs a little hotter than normal.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_thermostat_malfunction_stage2_description
text.text: Poor transmission thermostat response. The oil cooler opens far too late, the transmission oil runs well above its normal temperature and wears faster.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_thermostat_malfunction_stage3_description
text.text: The transmission thermostat barely opens the oil cooler. The transmission oil comes close to overheating as soon as the load rises.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_thermostat_malfunction_stage4_description
text.text: Complete transmission thermostat failure. It is frozen at one opening, so the transmission oil either overheats or never warms up, depending on where it stuck.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_oil_leak_stage1_description
text.text: Light transmission oil leak. The oil level drops slowly during work.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_oil_leak_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate transmission oil leak. The oil level drops noticeably and the transmission runs hotter.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_oil_leak_stage3_description
text.text: Severe transmission oil leak. The oil level drops quickly and the transmission overheats under load.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_transmission_oil_leak_stage4_description
text.text: Critical transmission oil leak. There is not enough oil left for safe operation of the transmission.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_track_tensioner_malfunction_stage1_description
text.text: Light track tensioner malfunction. Track tension is a little less stable, which slightly increases drag and wear.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_track_tensioner_malfunction_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate track tensioner malfunction. Tension becomes unstable, running efficiency drops and the risk of misalignment increases.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_track_tensioner_malfunction_stage3_description
text.text: Severe track tensioner malfunction. Tension is heavily disturbed, drive transfer becomes inefficient and the risk of throwing a track increases.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_track_tensioner_malfunction_stage4_description
text.text: Critical track tensioner failure. The track can no longer be held correctly and the vehicle can no longer be operated safely.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_thermostat_malfunction_stage1_description
text.text: The engine thermostat is beginning to fail. The engine takes longer to reach optimal temperature or runs slightly hot.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_thermostat_malfunction_stage2_description
text.text: Thermostat response is poor. Engine temperature regulation is unstable, increasing wear.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_thermostat_malfunction_stage3_description
text.text: The thermostat barely opens any more. The engine overheats as soon as the load rises.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_thermostat_malfunction_stage4_description
text.text: Complete thermostat failure. The engine coolant cannot circulate correctly, leading to severe and rapid overheating.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_overheat_protection_stage1_description
text.text: The engine has entered protection mode. Power is limited until the temperature drops.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_overheat_protection_stage2_description
text.text: Overheat protection is tightening. The engine delivers only half its power.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_overheat_protection_stage3_description
text.text: Overheat protection is at its maximum. Only a fraction of engine power remains.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_overheat_protection_stage4_description
text.text: The engine has been shut down to prevent damage. Let it cool before restarting.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_overload_breakdown_stage2_message
text.text: Critical overload! Reduce the load on the vehicle immediately.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_oil_pump_malfunction_stage1_description
text.text: Light oil pump malfunction. Oil pressure is reduced, engine torque drops slightly, engine temperature rises and mechanical knocking may appear.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_oil_pump_malfunction_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate oil pump malfunction. Oil pressure is insufficient, engine torque is noticeably reduced, engine temperature is increased, and mechanical knocking is clearly audible.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_oil_pump_malfunction_stage3_description
text.text: Severe oil pump malfunction. Oil pressure is critically low, engine torque is heavily reduced, engine overheating is likely, mechanical knocking is severe, and engine stalls may occur.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_oil_pump_malfunction_stage4_description
text.text: Critical oil pump failure. Oil circulation is insufficient for safe engine operation and engine start or further operation is not possible.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_engine_jam_stage1_description
text.text: The engine has jammed and can no longer turn.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_ecu_malfunction_stage1_description
text.text: Light ECU malfunction. Slightly reduced engine power.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_ecu_malfunction_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate ECU malfunction. Noticeable power loss and increased fuel consumption.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_ecu_malfunction_stage3_description
text.text: Severe ECU malfunction. Major power loss, high fuel consumption and a risk of the engine stalling.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_ecu_malfunction_stage4_description
text.text: Complete ECU failure. The engine cannot be controlled and will not start.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_corroded_wiring_stage1_description
text.text: Light corrosion of wiring and electrical connectors. Increased contact resistance causes occasional light flicker, unstable supply and hard starting.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_corroded_wiring_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate corrosion of wiring and electrical connectors. Contact losses cause frequent light flicker, unstable voltage supply, difficult engine starting, and possible engine stalls.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_corroded_wiring_stage3_description
text.text: Severe corrosion of wiring and electrical connectors. Power supply to critical circuits is unstable, lighting may fail completely, engine torque is reduced, engine stalls are likely, and starting is unreliable.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_corroded_wiring_stage4_description
text.text: Failure of the starter control circuit caused by severe wiring corrosion. Lighting is inoperative and engine start is impossible.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_coolant_leak_stage1_description
text.text: Light coolant leak. Cooling efficiency is slightly reduced.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_coolant_leak_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate coolant leak. Cooling capacity drops noticeably and engine temperature climbs more quickly.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_coolant_leak_stage3_description
text.text: Severe coolant leak. Cooling loss is significant and the risk of overheating becomes high.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_coolant_leak_stage4_description
text.text: Critical cooling system failure. There is not enough coolant for safe engine operation.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cvt_chain_wear_stage1_description
text.text: Light CVT chain wear. Slight slip appears under load and transmission efficiency drops a little.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cvt_chain_wear_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate CVT chain wear. Slip becomes noticeable under load and the ratio varies less precisely.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cvt_chain_wear_stage3_description
text.text: Severe CVT chain wear. Slip is heavy, efficiency drops sharply and the transmission struggles to hold the requested ratio.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cvt_chain_wear_stage4_description
text.text: Critical CVT chain failure. The transmission no longer passes torque correctly and the vehicle becomes practically unusable.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cvt_addon_malfunction_stage1_description
text.text: Early signs of a CVT transmission malfunction have been detected. An inspection and a repair are required.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cvt_addon_malfunction_stage2_description
text.text: The CVT transmission malfunction is getting worse. Continued operation may lead to emergency mode.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cvt_addon_malfunction_stage3_description
text.text: Critical CVT transmission damage. The transmission is in emergency mode and the maximum vehicle speed is reduced.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_cvt_addon_malfunction_stage4_description
text.text: Complete CVT transmission failure. The vehicle cannot be used until it is repaired.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_battery_sulfation_stage1_description
text.text: Light battery sulfation. Effective capacity is reduced, lowering the electrical reserve under load.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_battery_sulfation_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate battery sulfation. Effective battery capacity is significantly reduced and engine starting is difficult.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_battery_sulfation_stage3_description
text.text: Severe battery sulfation. Usable battery capacity is critically low and cranking performance is unstable.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_battery_sulfation_stage4_description
text.text: Critical battery sulfation. Effective capacity is almost nil and cranking power is insufficient for a reliable start.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_brake_malfunction_stage1_description
text.text: Worn brake pads. A slight decrease in braking effectiveness.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_brake_malfunction_stage2_description
text.text: Leaking brake fluid or worn discs. Braking distance is noticeably increased.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_brake_malfunction_stage3_description
text.text: Severe loss of brake pressure. Brakes are very weak and unreliable.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_brake_malfunction_stage4_description
text.text: Complete brake system failure. Further operation is extremely dangerous.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_bearing_wear_stage1_description
text.text: Light bearing wear. Mechanical resistance rises slightly and an unusual running noise may appear.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_bearing_wear_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate bearing wear. Friction rises noticeably, the noise becomes more pronounced and mechanical efficiency drops.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_bearing_wear_stage3_description
text.text: Severe bearing wear. Friction is high, the noise is loud and there is a real risk of seizure under load.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_bearing_wear_stage4_description
text.text: Critical bearing failure. They are close to complete seizure and operation becomes impossible.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_alternator_regulator_failure_stage1_description
text.text: Light alternator regulator failure. Charging output is reduced, which lowers battery charging efficiency.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_alternator_regulator_failure_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate alternator regulator failure. Charging is reduced and unstable, causing poor battery charging and increased voltage losses.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_alternator_regulator_failure_stage3_description
text.text: Severe alternator regulator failure. Charging is heavily reduced, the supply is unstable and the electrical system operates with major losses.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_alternator_regulator_failure_stage4_description
text.text: Complete alternator regulator failure. Battery charging is absent and the electrical system is operating only from the remaining battery reserve.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_valve_train_malfunction_stage1_description
text.text: Light valve train malfunction. Engine torque is slightly reduced, fuel consumption rises and abnormal noise appears in the mechanism.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_valve_train_malfunction_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate valve train malfunction. Engine torque is noticeably reduced, fuel consumption is increased, valve train noise is pronounced, and engine hesitation may occur under load.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_valve_train_malfunction_stage3_description
text.text: Severe valve train malfunction. Engine torque is heavily reduced, fuel consumption is significantly increased, valve train noise is severe, engine hesitation is frequent, and engine stalls may occur.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_valve_train_malfunction_stage4_description
text.text: Critical valve train failure. The engine can no longer run reliably, and starting or continued operation is no longer possible.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fuel_pump_malfunction_stage1_description
text.text: Early fuel pump wear. Slightly reduced engine power and increased fuel consumption.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fuel_pump_malfunction_stage2_description
text.text: Fuel pressure dropping. Noticeable power loss, higher fuel consumption, and occasional engine stalls.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fuel_pump_malfunction_stage3_description
text.text: Critical fuel pressure. Severe power loss, very high fuel consumption, and frequent engine stalls.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fuel_pump_malfunction_stage4_description
text.text: Complete fuel pump failure. Fuel is not supplied to the engine.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fuel_injector_malfunction_stage1_description
text.text: One or more injectors have slightly clogged nozzles. The engine may run a bit rough, with a minor loss of power.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fuel_injector_malfunction_stage2_description
text.text: Poor fuel atomization. The engine hesitates under load, with noticeable power loss and jerking.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fuel_injector_malfunction_stage3_description
text.text: A fuel injector is stuck. The engine runs very poorly, with significant power loss and unreliable starting.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fuel_injector_malfunction_stage4_description
text.text: An injector has completely failed. The engine will not run correctly and may not start at all.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fuel_filter_clogging_stage1_description
text.text: Light fuel filter clogging. Fuel flow drops slightly under heavy load.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fuel_filter_clogging_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate fuel filter clogging. Flow becomes insufficient under load, power drops and the engine sometimes hesitates.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fuel_filter_clogging_stage3_description
text.text: Severe fuel filter clogging. Fuel supply is heavily restricted, power drops noticeably and stalls are possible.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fuel_filter_clogging_stage4_description
text.text: Fuel filter fully obstructed. The engine no longer receives enough fuel to run reliably.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fuel_line_air_leak_stage1_description
text.text: Light air leak in the fuel line. Fuel supply becomes slightly irregular.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fuel_line_air_leak_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate air leak in the fuel line. The supply becomes unstable, power drops and hesitation appears.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fuel_line_air_leak_stage3_description
text.text: Severe air leak in the fuel line. The engine runs very unevenly and the risk of stalling is high.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fuel_line_air_leak_stage4_description
text.text: Critical fuel line failure with a major air leak. The engine can no longer be supplied correctly.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fan_clutch_failure_stage1_description
text.text: Light fan clutch failure. The fan responds less effectively and cooling is slightly degraded.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fan_clutch_failure_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate fan clutch failure. Fan engagement is erratic and cooling efficiency drops noticeably.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fan_clutch_failure_stage3_description
text.text: Severe fan clutch failure. The fan no longer provides enough airflow and the engine overheats more easily.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_fan_clutch_failure_stage4_description
text.text: Critical fan clutch failure. The fan can no longer provide the necessary cooling.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_control_valve_malfunction_stage1_description
text.text: Light CVT hydraulic control valve malfunction. Transmission response is slightly slower and less precise.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_control_valve_malfunction_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate CVT hydraulic control valve malfunction. Pressure is unstable, ratio changes are slower and efficiency drops noticeably.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_control_valve_malfunction_stage3_description
text.text: Severe CVT hydraulic control valve malfunction. Pressure is very erratic, the transmission responds poorly and transmitted power drops sharply.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_control_valve_malfunction_stage4_description
text.text: Critical CVT hydraulic control valve failure. Pressure can no longer be controlled and the transmission becomes unusable.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_cylinder_internal_leak_stage1_description
text.text: Minor internal leakage in a hydraulic cylinder. A raised implement drifts slowly under load.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_cylinder_internal_leak_stage2_description
text.text: Moderate internal leakage in a hydraulic cylinder. Downward drift is noticeable and increases with the carried load.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_cylinder_internal_leak_stage3_description
text.text: Severe internal leakage in a hydraulic cylinder. Heavy implements can no longer reliably hold their position.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_cylinder_internal_leak_stage4_description
text.text: Critical internal leakage in a hydraulic cylinder. Any raised load drops rapidly on its own.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_pump_malfunction_stage1_description
text.text: Minor internal leak in the hydraulic pump. Implements operate slightly more slowly.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_pump_malfunction_stage2_description
text.text: Worn seals on the hydraulic pump. Noticeably slower hydraulic operation.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_pump_malfunction_stage3_description
text.text: Damaged hydraulic pump. Implements are extremely slow and weak.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_pump_malfunction_stage4_description
text.text: Hydraulic pump failure. Hydraulic system is inoperable.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_hose_external_leak_stage1_description
text.text: A hydraulic hose shows light moisture. A little oil escapes and hydraulic response is slightly reduced.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_hose_external_leak_stage2_description
text.text: A hydraulic hose is visibly seeping. Oil loss continues and hydraulic functions respond more slowly.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_hose_external_leak_stage3_description
text.text: A hydraulic hose is actively leaking. Oil loss is obvious and hydraulic functions are noticeably weakened.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_hose_external_leak_stage4_description
text.text: A hydraulic hose has a severe external leak. Oil is escaping quickly and hydraulic performance is strongly reduced.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_filter_clogging_stage1_description
text.text: The hydraulic filter is slightly clogged and beginning to restrict flow. Hydraulic functions are slightly slower. Maintenance replaces the filter.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_filter_clogging_stage2_description
text.text: The hydraulic filter is moderately clogged. All hydraulic functions are noticeably slower. Maintenance replaces the filter.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_filter_clogging_stage3_description
text.text: The hydraulic filter is heavily clogged. Hydraulic response is very slow. Maintenance replaces the filter.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_filter_clogging_stage4_description
text.text: The hydraulic filter is fully obstructed. Hydraulic functions barely respond. Maintenance replaces the filter.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_oil_cooler_malfunction_stage1_description
text.text: The hydraulic oil cooler has lost some efficiency. Oil temperature rises slightly during prolonged hydraulic work.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_oil_cooler_malfunction_stage2_description
text.text: The hydraulic oil cooler is underperforming. Oil temperature rises noticeably during sustained hydraulic work.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_oil_cooler_malfunction_stage3_description
text.text: The hydraulic oil cooler is badly degraded. Heavy hydraulic work quickly overheats the oil.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_oil_cooler_malfunction_stage4_description
text.text: The hydraulic oil cooler has failed. Prolonged hydraulic work causes severe oil overheating and accelerates pump wear.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_spool_valve_stage1_description
text.text: A hydraulic control valve is beginning to stick. One hydraulic function occasionally hesitates and weakens under load.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_spool_valve_stage2_description
text.text: A hydraulic control valve is sticking intermittently. One hydraulic function is slower and loses more force as load increases.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_spool_valve_stage3_description
text.text: A hydraulic control valve is sticking badly. One hydraulic function moves erratically and struggles under heavy load.

text.name: rms_breakdowns_hydraulic_spool_valve_stage4_description
text.text: A hydraulic control valve is critically damaged. One hydraulic function repeatedly stops and can barely move a heavy load.

text.text: Visual inspection: quick and inexpensive, it searches only for breakdowns that are already active, with reduced detection ability. The report does not show detailed component condition.

text.name: rms_option_menu_inspection_complete_description

text.name: rms_option_menu_maintenance_minimal_description

text.name: rms_option_menu_maintenance_standard_description
text.text: Standard maintenance: restores the reference maintenance level, replaces the engine oil, and tops up the other circuits when required.

text.name: rms_option_menu_maintenance_extended_description

text.name: rms_option_menu_maintenance_preventive_description

text.name: rms_option_menu_repair_type_fix_description

text.name: rms_option_menu_repair_type_replacement_description

text.name: rms_option_menu_repair_type_advanced_description
text.text: Advanced repair: removes the breakdown, replaces the failed component, and clears accumulated mechanical stress from the affected system.

text.name: rms_tutorial_fluid_level_message
text.text:
One of the fluids on this machine has dropped below the mark on its gauge.
Engine oil is burnt off as the hours pass, and a tired engine drinks far more of it. Coolant, transmission oil and hydraulic oil only go down through a leak.
Under the mark the machine is only asking for a top-up and still works normally. It is when a level falls really low that the damage starts: a machine short of coolant or of transmission oil runs hot, and a machine short of engine oil or of hydraulic oil wears far faster.
Buy a container of compatible product in the shop, place it beside the machine and top up the level. All products intended for that circuit have the same effect; a wrong fluid contaminates only that circuit. At the dealer, the required liters are supplied and charged. At a personal or mobile workshop, the procedure consumes farm-owned containers inside the workshop zone.

text.name: rms_tutorial_welcome_message
text.text:
This mod completely overhauls the vehicle damage and maintenance systems in the game. There are many changes, so tutorial tips will appear from time to time. They will help you understand the new mechanics more quickly, avoid common mistakes, and keep your machines from breaking down.
If you want, you can disable tutorial tips right now. You can always enable them again later in the mod settings, under the Realistic Mechanical Systems section.

text.name: rms_tutorial_wet_weather_message
text.text: Moisture damages wiring and electrical equipment. Electrical system wear rises slightly in rain, snow or hail on a machine left outdoors.

text.name: rms_tutorial_wheel_slip_message
text.text: Your wheels are slipping badly. Slip is one of the most destructive factors for the transmission and brings your next workshop visit much closer.

text.name: rms_tutorial_service_due_soon_message
text.text:
%s will soon need maintenance.
In RMS, vehicles require regular maintenance. If you delay it, the risk of breakdowns rises significantly.
Visit the nearest workshop and select "Maintenance". The interval can be adjusted in the mod settings.

text.name: rms_tutorial_service_interval_expired_message
text.text:
The maintenance interval of %s has expired.
Head to a workshop as soon as possible and select "Maintenance". Continuing to operate a vehicle with overdue maintenance greatly increases the risk of multiple breakdowns.

text.name: rms_tutorial_steering_message
text.text:
It is best not to steer while standing still. This puts a heavy load on the steering gear and front axle components, which increases wear on the running gear.
Move forward slightly before turning: the wheels will turn much more easily.

text.name: rms_tutorial_rad_or_filter_clogged_message
text.text:
Your vehicle's radiator and air filter are heavily clogged.
A clogged radiator cannot dissipate heat efficiently, and a clogged air filter restricts airflow to the engine. This reduces power and increases fuel consumption.
The radiator can be cleaned at a washing station or with the Air Blower. The air filter can only be blown out, and blowing it out never restores it fully: only workshop maintenance replaces it.
You can check the condition of both: hold the %s key while looking at the vehicle.

text.name: rms_tutorial_needs_lubrication_message
text.text:
Your %s needs regular lubrication.
In RMS, the lubrication level drops with operating hours. After a long period without use, lubrication is also required before returning the machine to service. Insufficient lubrication accelerates chassis wear.
Buy a Grease Gun in the shop and lubricate the machine when the inspection calls for it.
You can check the lubrication level: hold the %s key while looking at the vehicle.

text.name: rms_tutorial_needs_repair_message
text.text:
Your %s has a problem. One of its parts may have failed.
Take it to the workshop for an inspection. Do not wait: the breakdown can keep worsening, and the repair cost rises with it.
If the inspection confirms the breakdown, have it repaired at the workshop.

text.name: rms_tutorial_needs_overhaul_message
text.text:
Your %s is showing its age. It is time to consider a replacement or an overhaul. It is a long and expensive operation, but it is the only way to return the machine to its original condition.
Vehicle lifespan is set in the mod settings: the higher it is, the slower your vehicles wear.

text.name: rms_tutorial_needs_preventive_message
text.text:
One of your %s systems is about to fail. There is still time to act.
The workshop offers preventive maintenance: it restores the maintenance level, replaces all fluids, and sharply reduces mechanical stress in the most exposed systems.

text.name: rms_tutorial_age_degradation_message
text.text:
In RMS, vehicles gradually lose part of their original performance as they age.
After about a third of their lifespan, age wear slightly reduces important characteristics such as power or braking. The effect then strengthens and becomes clearly visible near the end of life.
This degradation can be disabled in the mod settings.

text.name: rms_tutorial_poor_consumables_message
text.text:
Your %s received poor-quality consumables at its last maintenance. This happens with the cheaper grades.
The maintenance interval is shortened and component wear slightly increased. New maintenance fixes the problem. A visual or standard inspection reports the shortened interval; only a complete inspection identifies the consumables involved.

text.name: rms_tutorial_poor_parts_message
text.text:
Your %s received a poor-quality part during a repair. The breakdown will most likely return soon.
You can wait for it to come back, or run a complete inspection, which identifies the faulty part reliably.

text.name: rms_tutorial_park_brake_message
text.text:
The parking brake is engaged. It engages by itself once you leave the machine at a standstill, and it releases as soon as you press the throttle again.
On a slope, it is what keeps the machine from rolling away on its own.

text.name: rms_tutorial_park_brake_manual_message
text.text:
The parking brake is engaged. You engage and release it yourself with its own key: press the throttle with the brake engaged and the machine stays put, with a warning.
On a slope, it is what keeps the machine from rolling away on its own.

text.name: rms_tutorial_preheat_message
text.text: On a cold diesel engine, one press of the start control switches on the ignition and begins the automatic glow-plug cycle. The dashboard lamps light up briefly, then the preheat lamp remains on until the engine is ready. Do not repeat the command: the starter engages automatically when the lamp goes out.

text.name: rms_tutorial_pto_engagement_message
text.text: Engaging and disengaging the PTO repeatedly accumulates mechanical cycles. Avoid unnecessary engagements.

text.name: rms_tutorial_idle_and_downtime_message
text.text: Wear is much lower when the machine is running without working. With the engine off it becomes minimal. Under cover, it disappears entirely.

text.name: rms_tutorial_idle_deposit_message
text.text:
The machine has been idling for too long. Long idle periods do not just waste fuel: over time they also encourage deposits in the fuel system and harm the general condition of the engine.
If the machine is not needed right now, it is better to shut the engine down.

text.name: rms_tutorial_hot_weather_message
text.text:
It is very hot today. In this weather, watch the radiator cleanliness and avoid overloading the engine, or overheating is only a matter of time.
You can check the radiator condition: hold the %s key while looking at the machine. Cleaning is done with the Air Blower.

text.name: rms_tutorial_heavy_trailer_message
text.text:
The towed load looks too heavy for this vehicle. You can keep driving, but the transmission and drivetrain will take more strain.
RMS uses two references: a tractor needs at least 10 hp per tonne towed, and a truck at least 6 hp per tonne of gross combined weight. Below the applicable value and under high engine load, transmission wear increases.

text.name: rms_tutorial_hard_start_message
text.text:
The engine of your %s is hard to start. A weak battery, frost, a mechanical breakdown or starter wear can be the cause. Hold the start button until the engine fires.
The electrical system takes heavy loads during starting, because of the high inrush currents.

text.name: rms_tutorial_low_fuel_message
text.text: The tank is nearing reserve. The less fuel is left, the harder the fuel pump has to work to draw it, which increases its wear.

text.name: rms_tutorial_lugging_message
text.text: The engine, and especially the transmission, do not like lugging: low engine speed under heavy load. The attached implement may be too heavy for the machine, or the selected gear is not the right one if the gearbox is manual.

text.name: rms_tutorial_engine_overheat_message
text.text:
The engine is starting to overheat. This can happen for one or several reasons: the engine is under heavy load, the radiator is clogged, the weather is hot, or there is a fault in the vehicle's cooling system.
Stay alert: overheating is one of the most destructive factors for any machine. It does not only harm the engine: the cooling system is pushed to its limit, and heat in the engine bay accelerates the degradation of wiring and electrical components.

text.name: rms_tutorial_engine_overload_message
text.text:
The engine is under very heavy strain. The task may be too much for this machine and call for a more powerful vehicle, or it may be enough to slow down to reduce the load.
In any case, wear rises noticeably under this strain.

text.name: rms_tutorial_exhaust_smoke_message
text.text:
The smoke coming out of this machine is not decoration: its color is a diagnosis.
Black smoke means the engine is getting more fuel than air: a hard pickup before the turbocharger has come up to speed, an engine lugging at low speed, overload, a clogged air filter, a tired turbocharger or worn injection. Blue smoke means a tired engine burning its own oil. White smoke means fuel leaving unburnt.
The plume also grows with the work the engine is doing. Older machines smoke far more than recent ones, and that is normal.

text.name: rms_tutorial_cvt_overheat_message
text.text:
The CVT transmission is starting to overheat. It can come from excessive load, a clogged radiator, very hot weather, or a fault in the transmission cooling circuit. A plow that is too heavy or an overloaded trailer is enough to cause it.
Stay alert: overheating is one of the most destructive factors for a CVT transmission.

text.name: rms_tutorial_chassis_vibration_message
text.text:
Driving fast over rough terrain quickly wears out the suspension of your %s. These vibrations also damage the other systems, hydraulics and electrics first.
Drive smoothly on uneven ground.

text.name: rms_tutorial_cranking_message
text.text:
The engine is being started too often. Every start sends a very high current through the electrical system, which accelerates wear on the wiring, the starter and the other electrical components.
Avoid shutting the engine down for short breaks.

text.name: rms_tutorial_critical_failure_message
text.text:
Your %s can no longer move under its own power.
A mobile workshop allows a temporary repair, enough for the machine to reach the workshop on its own. Otherwise, you will have to have it recovered another way.

text.name: rms_tutorial_cold_engine_message
text.text: Warm the engine gently before applying high load. Use moderate throttle and engine speed until it reaches operating temperature.

text.name: rms_tutorial_cold_oil_message
text.text: Transmission and hydraulic oil warms much more slowly than the engine. Avoid heavy work while the oil is cold; warm it gradually with light driving and light hydraulic use.

text.name: rms_tutorial_transmission_overheat_message
text.text:
The transmission oil is starting to overheat. It can come from too much load, a clogged radiator, very hot weather, or a fault in the transmission cooling.
Transmission oil heats up on every machine, not only on a CVT. Oil that runs too hot wears the gearbox and destroys its seals.

text.name: rms_tutorial_overload_indicator_message
text.text:
%s is under heavy load. The warning indicator that just lit up on the dashboard is letting you know.
The machine may not have enough power for the current task. Try reducing the load: limit your speed with cruise control, or ease off the throttle instead of running at full power.

text.name: rms_tutorial_battery_low_message
text.text:
The battery of this machine is about to go flat. This happens after a long period of standing, in severe cold, or because of an electrical system fault.
At low charge, starting becomes difficult and then impossible. You can then start the engine from another vehicle using the jumper cables.

text.name: rms_tutorial_drivetrain_windup_message
text.text: You are turning on a high-grip surface with the differential lock engaged. Inside and outside wheels travel different distances in a curve, but the differential lock forces them to rotate at the same speed: the drivetrain comes under stress and transmission wear increases. Release the differential lock before turning.

text.name: rms_tutorial_drivetrain_modes_message
text.text:
This machine lets you choose its drivetrain: 2WD, 4WD or AUTO, which engages the front axle as soon as the wheels slip.
The differential lock finds grip where there is none left, but it costs dearly when turning on a high-grip surface: inner and outer wheels cannot turn at the same speed, and the drivetrain takes the strain. Release it before you turn.
